# Per-project agreement with dm.exe. A RATCHET on the missed column.
#
# Local only: these are games on disk, not in this repo, so CI cannot run it.
# Keyed by .dme file name, since paths differ per machine and names do not.
#
# Update deliberately, after reading why a number moved:
#   dmc diagdiff <dme> --baseline <this file> --update
#
# THE DEFINES ARE NOT IN THE KEY, AND ONE ROW NEEDS THEM. tgstation builds with -DCBT, so
# re-running it without one compiles a different program from the one the row was measured on -
# the same failure as diagdiff not passing -D to dm.exe, which is what made tgstation
# unmeasurable until 2026-08-05. The other three take no flags.
#   dmc diagdiff <path>\tgstation.dme -DCBT --baseline <this file>
#
# dme	agreed	missed	invented
hell.dme	4	0	0
Klan Wars.dme	15	0	0
spies.dme	0	0	0
tgstation.dme	0	0	0
